objective: 一个一个部分重写然后紧紧用 cell 概念连接，避免存在不同路径和不同接口定义并维持运行速度和常用指标，因为这可以度量你是否完全重写了所有重要优化点
acceptance_rule: Each optimization needs removed duplicate implementation, common Cell wiring, exercised semantic checks, preserved/reduced net work and relevant timing; unchanged counters alone do not prove a rewrite.

parts.requirement: One Cell Site/Definition for relation operands and SSA aliases; remove the duplicate known-results, continuation, structural-port and iterative-Bake source definitions.
reproduction: cargo run --release --locked -p eggfuse-cell-runtime --features sparse-cells,view-ports,storage-metrics --example audit_cell_relower -- out/cell-unification/sum/program.json out/cell-unification/relower.json

parts.requirement: Shared Entry supplies Cell bindings and established query facts; remove covered history/route recovery while preserving late inputs and delta ownership.
completed_structure: Compile admitted Cell result sources to shared slots; retain only actual returned references.
RHS reuse, query receipts and prefix receipts read the same Results layout; source-tag searches removed.
Prefix reads borrow current Cell results without cloning the published History.
One borrowed Cell Entry supplies the row, shared Consumer definition and publication location to every batch reader; packet/published_packet/seed(packet) APIs removed.
Entry-managed residual seeds carry the existing publication slot without growing the 24-byte sparse Seed; covered witness-map probes and unnecessary physical producer recovery removed.
remaining: Full and residual operands now share Cell Query; still remove divergent producer-route recovery and prefix plan comparisons across the Entry boundary.
Unify the legacy publication boundary owner where its coverage permits; retain exact fallback behavior until then.
Verify speed after removing remaining dispatch work; current entry-delivery timing is inconclusive and does not establish a gain.
parts.verification: shared result ports and delivered Entry provenance verified; full/partial query plans and performance acceptance remain incomplete
parts.opportunity: The previous sum-bits execution retained 1,508 results; 592 result reads now use compiled slots. Prefix dispatch is not exercised by sum-bits and is covered separately by witness_sources/register_prefix fixtures.
parts.live_obligations: Actual result reference, current row/key/visibility, delta ownership and source Run ordering. Existing bounded history remains for results spanning multiple stages.
reproduction: cargo run --release --locked -p eggfuse-cell-runtime --features sparse-cells,view-ports,storage-metrics --example audit_cell_relower -- out/cell-entry-ports/sum/program.json out/cell-entry-ports/relower.json

delivery.opportunity: Previous normal execution delivered 12,066 shared seeds. The reused/replaced short fixtures exercise prefix handoff that sum-bits does not enter.
delivery.lifetime_proof: Only the matching invocation consumes the private publication handle. Delivery completes before RHS publication, arena reuse and the next query snapshot; mutable Entry ownership is not shared with workers. Later overlap across this boundary must add an appropriate lifetime proof.
delivery.limits: No route-comparison savings yet. Ordinary graph key lookups and logical/committed work are unchanged. Runtime allocation requests are unchanged; setup requests shrink, but RSS and time must still be assessed.

parts.requirement: Compile residual queries from the same Cell and Entry; preserve register, join, sieve, range and neighbor optimizations under the common contract.
completed_structure: One complete Cell query compiler/executor replaces ordinary slot interpretation, single-Port execution and staged Block execution.
Program, Bake admission and iterative composition share the query definition; remove catalog-owned Block data and dispatch reference clones.
Complete Entry and residual register planning share one deterministic query-order compiler with explicit expansion budgets.
Repair Cells use the same query instruction binder and static dataflow composition.
Residual Query uses the same Field and Step definitions; old register Step/seed/assign execution and source-slot readers removed.
Anchor and current candidate columns are borrowed; computed values and prefix continuations use the common Cell instruction positions.
Complete and residual entries reuse the same Rc<Query> when their certified order agrees; 177 shared plans on sum-bits.
Common BoundStep borrows expected output values, including source entries and repair Cells.
remaining: Unify remaining entry-strategy routing and full/prefix donor recovery; one Query IR alone does not remove boundary dispatch.
Audit and integrate Free Join, sieve, range, local-context and view capabilities under Cell entries; preserve their coverage and delta ownership.
Resolve plan/loading/representation overhead: this residual rewrite has no demonstrated speedup and still increases peak RSS.
Finish boundary publication and scope/parallel rewrites before the historical-fastest and Raytrace acceptance campaign.
parts.opportunity: Previous sum-bits execution had 5,738 full entries, only 3,828 admitted by Bake. The other entries still constructed query environments; the selected entries split into two executors.
parts.live_obligations: Exact current-key reads and output checks, pivot validation, witness identity/visibility, source Run boundaries and winner ordering; residual enumeration retains its own delta ownership.
parts.verification: 300 test executions across compiler/runtime feature sets, 22 identical re-lowered compiler components, semantic acceptance pass and identical Run/state/ordered mutation diagnostics. Normal short sum-bits inference median 24.719125 ms -> 24.285 ms; no general-workload or whole-goal performance claim.
reproduction: cargo run --locked -p eggfuse-cell-runtime --features sparse-cells,view-ports,storage-metrics --example audit_cell_relower -- out/cell-query-unified/sum/program.json out/cell-query-unified/relower.json

residual.opportunity: Residual matching copied seed fields into rule slots and assigned each candidate column before checking it; complete-query programs duplicated eligible residual programs.
residual.live_obligations: Borrow only current immutable matching rows; preserve repeated variables, scalar guards, residual enumeration, delta ownership, exact prefix fallback pc, Run barriers and active result witnesses.
residual.verification: 301 test executions, unchanged 22 compiler components, sum-bits semantic pass and exact Run/state/mutation diagnostics; three frozen-runtime fixtures including repeated candidate aliases and late delta. Existing work counters unchanged; execute allocation requests -70,144 bytes. Timing acceptance remains unresolved.
reproduction: cargo run --locked -p eggfuse-cell-runtime --features sparse-cells,view-ports,storage-metrics --example audit_cell_relower -- out/cell-residual-unified/sum/program.json out/cell-residual-unified/relower.json

parts.requirement: Use Cell result slots for RHS reuse and final Entry publication; remove covered per-anchor packets and Pending round trips.
One Cell wiring and lifecycle for stable ports, symbolic composition and equality conditions; prove coverage before removing old maintenance.
Derive completion scopes, workers and ordered publication from Cell dependencies; retain profitable optimizations and charge discarded work.
Compose and select the same Cell definitions and Entries; update optional marker materialization boundaries during iteration.
Audit all optimization groups structurally and dynamically, then compare sum-bits and Raytrace with the pre-rewrite and historical fastest controls.
